description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing shopping cart state in a restaurant ordering application. It includes hooks for accessing and manipulating cart items, calculating total price, and providing methods to add, remove, update item quantities, and clear the cart.

methods.name: CartProvider
methods.description: React component providing cart state and manipulation methods to descendants.

methods.name: useCart
methods.description: Custom hook to access cart state and functions from context.
